metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the Hall, the picture under the hammer-beam, and Margery's count at the stair.

yesterday: A shortened grievance came back longer. The sheet was the clerk's. Two shillings was his fee.
Two Gents played to black gowns. You stood in the parlour door. Thirty-three shillings was Margery's stair.
The book is still with Abel. Tomorrow you and Heminges take it to St John's.
The fee, if he signs, is seven shillings of the company's.
Richard the Third is at two tomorrow, and you are not in it.
